lang: en

# Sends readers to their language: the last one they chose with the navbar
# switch (see style/lang-switch.html), otherwise their browser's language.
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <script>
    (function () {
      var lang = null;
      try { lang = localStorage.getItem("codif-ape-lang"); } catch (e) {}
      if (lang !== "en" && lang !== "fr") {
        lang = /^fr\b/i.test(navigator.language || "") ? "fr" : "en";
      }
      window.location.replace(lang + "/index.html" + window.location.hash);
    })();
    </script>
    <noscript><meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=en/index.html"></noscript>
